Name: Transmission parameter
Description: Initial value of the transmission parameter.

Name: Transmission parameter location
Description: Location parameter for transmission parameter distribution.

Name: Transmission parameter shape
Description: Shape parameter for transmission parameter distribution.

Name: Relative transmission on ART
Description: Transmission relative to untreated infection while on ART.

Name: Progression untreated
Description: Disease progression rate for untreated infected individuals.

Name: Progression treated
Description: Disease progression rate for treated infected individuals.

Name: CD4 on/off
Description: Whether CD4-based treatment initiation is enabled.

Name: Final phase duration
Description: Duration of final phase as a proportion of expected life.

Name: Start ART CD4
Description: CD4 threshold for starting ART in the table as presented.

Name: Monte Carlo repeats
Description: Number of Monte Carlo simulation repeats.
